summary.short: Sets rules for new or expanded wholesale-market demands of at least 0.5% of average MEM demand (XDEM), with data-processing and production subcategories: registration, prior enablement, a supply plan, 80% contracted new energy, 100% or 115% new firm capacity, surcharges and technical specifications. In force 25 September 2026.
summary.long: Res. SE 264/2026 replaces Article 13 of Resolución SE 400/2025 and approves an annex, inserted as Appendix C of Annex 17 of 'Los Procedimientos', on Extratrend Demands (XDEM): new or expanded demand joining the wholesale electricity market (MEM) equal to or above 0.5% of average reference MEM demand. Demand of one project or linked group may not be split to avoid the threshold. XDEM are a subcategory of Large Major Users (GUMA): XDEM-DATOS (data centres, AI training or inference) and XDEM-PRODUCCIÓN (industry, mining, LNG, hydrogen). An XDEM registers with the Energy Secretariat, files a sworn five-year Special Supply Plan, is evaluated by the dispatch body (CAMMESA) and needs the Secretariat's prior enablement. It must contract each month at least 80% of its energy, and firm capacity of 100% (115% for XDEM-DATOS) of maximum demand, from new eligible supply. Uncovered energy pays the period energy value plus 100% (DATOS) or 50% (PRODUCCIÓN); uncovered capacity pays the large-user capacity charge plus 400% or 200%. Capacity awaiting transmission expansions costs USD 2,500/MW per quarter, partly refundable. A sub-annex sets connection studies and performance requirements. The regime applies for 15 years from commercial enablement; pending applications must adapt within 60 days.

territorial_scope.description: Applies to large demands joining Argentina's wholesale electricity market (MEM) through the national interconnected system (SADI), under federal jurisdiction.

evidence.quote: El SADI y las transacciones que se realizan a través del mismo están sujetas a regulación y jurisdicción federal.

thresholds.variable_text: incremento relativo [...] de la demanda media del MEM
thresholds.value_text: exceda en al menos un CERO COMA CINCO POR CIENTO (0,5%) de la demanda media del MEM
thresholds.measurement: Relative increase over average MEM demand
thresholds.consequence: The new or expanded demand is an Extratrend Demand (XDEM) and must file a Plan Especial de Abastecimiento
thresholds.conditions: Applies whether connected through transmission or distribution. Wording differs from Anexo Art. 1 ('igual o superior', 'incremento de potencia', 'demanda media de referencia'); both coded

evidence.provision: Res. Art. 1 (substituting Res. SE 400/2025, Art. 13, para. 1)
evidence.quote: Toda nueva demanda o ampliación de demanda que solicite su incorporación al MERCADO ELÉCTRICO MAYORISTA (MEM) y represente un incremento relativo que exceda en al menos un CERO COMA CINCO POR CIENTO (0,5%) de la demanda media del MEM será considerada Demanda Extratendencial (XDEM)

thresholds.variable_text: incremento de potencia [...] de la demanda media de referencia del MEM
thresholds.value_text: igual o superior al CERO COMA CINCO POR CIENTO (0,5 %) de la demanda media de referencia del MEM
thresholds.unit: percent of reference average MEM demand
thresholds.measurement: Reference average MEM demand computed by the OED as total MEM energy demanded over the 12 full calendar months before the request, divided by the hours of that period (Base Temporal); demand of one project, establishment or economically or technically linked set is counted as a whole and may not be split to avoid the threshold
thresholds.consequence: The demand is an XDEM and falls under the regime (subcategory GUMA-XDEM DATOS or PRODUCCIÓN)
thresholds.conditions: Request for MEM incorporation (and transmission access, where relevant) filed after Res. SE 400/2025 took effect; transmission or distribution connection

evidence.provision: Anexo, Art. 1 (definitions of Demanda Extratendencial and Base Temporal); Art. 3
evidence.quote: que represente un incremento de potencia igual o superior al CERO COMA CINCO POR CIENTO (0,5 %) de la demanda media de referencia del MEM

thresholds.variable_text: nueva producción de energía
thresholds.value_text: al menos un OCHENTA POR CIENTO (80%) de nueva producción de energía

evidence.quote: equivalente, como mínimo, al OCHENTA POR CIENTO (80%) de la energía efectivamente demandada durante el período mensual correspondiente

evidence.quote: consistente, como mínimo, con una capacidad de operación equivalente a un factor de potencia de 0,95 en el punto de conexión

thresholds.value_text: 30 MW/min
thresholds.consequence: Ramp limit for increases and reductions of load at the connection point; the lower of this and 10%/min applies
thresholds.conditions: Storage may be added to comply; ramps may be configurable at the operator's request

evidence.quote: La instalación deberá cumplir con el menor de los siguientes límites de variación de potencia activa (rampas), tanto en incremento como en reducción de carga: ● 30 MW/min

obligations.summary: Demand of one project, establishment or economically or technically linked set must be counted as a whole and may not be split into smaller demands to avoid XDEM classification.

evidence.provision: Anexo, Art. 1 (definition of Demanda Extratendencial); Art. 3
evidence.quote: deberá considerarse en forma integral, no pudiendo ser fraccionada, parcializada o ... subdividida en demandas de menor potencia cuando ello tenga por objeto o efecto evitar su encuadramiento como XDEM

obligations.summary: Every XDEM must register in the Registro de XDEM of the Secretaría de Energía, stating expected commercial-enablement date, power required, estimated annual energy, connection facilities, committed transmission expansions and the committed supply plan; registration does not itself enable it as a MEM agent.

evidence.quote: Toda Demanda Extratendencial (XDEM) deberá registrarse ante la Secretaría de Energía.

obligations.summary: An XDEM with self-generation must also declare total installed power, a staged load schedule, its associated generation (GAC) and its capacity to modulate withdrawals, and obtain separate Autogenerador enablement where applicable.

evidence.quote: En el caso de tratarse de una XDEM con autogeneración deberá registrarse ante la Secretaría de Energía declarando: potencia instalada total, cronograma de incorporación de carga por etapas, características de GAC, y capacidad de modulación de su retiro de la red.

obligations.summary: File with the Secretaría de Energía (copy to the OED), together with the transmission-access request to ENReGE, a sworn Plan Especial de Abastecimiento for the first five years: contracting commitments, location of new energy and capacity supply, schedules and backup; supply must come from Nueva Oferta Elegible XDEM.

evidence.provision: Anexo, Art. 5, paras. 1-2; Res. Art. 1 (substituting Res. SE 400/2025, Art. 13, para. 1)
evidence.quote: con carácter de Declaración Jurada un Plan Especial de Abastecimiento (PEA) para los primeros CINCO (5) años de funcionamiento

obligations.summary: Before commercial enablement, file a sworn updated supply plan with a 5-year rolling horizon: month-by-month maximum demand for 60 months, a certificate of capacity backing and energy coverage identifying contracts with new eligible supply, and grid studies validated by the transmission company; update it annually afterwards.
obligations.conditional_on: Before commercial enablement; annual updates from the following year

evidence.provision: Res. Art. 1 (substituting Res. SE 400/2025, Art. 13, para. 1)
evidence.quote: Toda nueva demanda o ampliación de demanda que solicite su incorporación al MERCADO ELÉCTRICO MAYORISTA (MEM) y represente un incremento relativo que exceda en al menos un CERO COMA CINCO POR CIENTO (0,5%) de la demanda media del MEM será considerada Demanda Extratendencial (XDEM), con independencia de que su vinculación al SADI se efectúe mediante instalaciones de transporte o de distribución.

notes: Text-internal issues, recorded as written: (1) The XDEM threshold is worded differently in the restated Res. SE 400/2025 Art. 13 ('incremento relativo que exceda en al menos un 0,5% de la demanda media del MEM') and in Anexo Art. 1 ('incremento de potencia igual o superior al 0,5% de la demanda media de referencia'); both are coded. (2) Art. 13 requires a supply plan securing 'al menos un 80% de nueva producción de energía' and power backing of 100%/115% 'de su consumo'; the Anexo sets monthly contractual coverage of 80% of energy demanded (Art. 9) and firm capacity of 100%/115% of maximum demand or maximum requirement (Arts. 5 and 10); all are coded. (3) Anexo Art. 5 names the 'Operador Encargado del Despacho'; elsewhere it is the 'Organismo Encargado del Despacho'. (4) Res. Art. 1 refers to 'la fecha prevista en el Artículo 6°' without naming the instrument (presumably Res. SE 400/2025). (5) Subanexo II point 2.2 refers performance criteria to 'punto 2' and point 3.12.2 to 'apartado 2.9.3'; the content is in points 3 and 3.9.3. (6) Anexo Art. 14 uses the acronym CICE, which Art. 11 does not define. (7) Subanexo I Art. 3 refers to 'Capacidad Firme Plena' and 'modalidades no firmes', and Art. 16 to a 'modalidad de conexión elegida', which the text does not define. Coding choices: duties of large loads use addressee 'enterprise' (any firm above the 0.5% size test) with 'data_center_operator' as also_addressee; duties of CAMMESA as OED use type government_duty with addressee utility_grid_operator; CICE and CDPF surcharges are coded as enforcement (sanction_type other), the capacity reservation charges and refunds as thresholds. Technical sampling rates, SMEC accuracy classes, the under-frequency load-shedding table and time-delayed frequency bands are summarised in obligations, not coded as thresholds. Left for the resolve stage: whether the 60-day periods are calendar or business days; the entry-into-force date of Res. SE 400/2025 (anchor of the XDEM cohort); the V-t curve in Figure 2 of Subanexo II (image only); any implementing rules of the Subsecretaría de Energía Eléctrica.
